instruction: Apply a Fade transition effect to all slides in note-taking-strategies.pptx and save the file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the saved PPTX file and extracts transition data by parsing the OOXML XML for each slide, checking for <p:fade> child element within <p:transition> — the correct representation for the Fade transition in PPTX format.
Metric correctly enforces the 'all slides' requirement: returns 1.0 only when every slide has the Fade transition (matching / total), and 0.0 when total == 0 or on error.
Expected configuration specifies transition_type='fade' which correctly corresponds to the Fade effect applied via LibreOffice Impress.
Negative control resistance is intact: the initial state has no transitions on any slide, so the evaluator will correctly return 0.0 before the task is performed.
The postconfig triggers ctrl+s to ensure the file is saved before getter reads it, correctly capturing the final file state.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened the pptx in Impress, navigated to Master View, selected all 7 objects, opened Format>Character dialog, and attempted a font change. Task failed at the font-typing step.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate the Impress UI: open menus (Slide Show, View), use Slide panel, apply transitions from the Transition panel
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent spent all turns on font change via master view and could not complete. Transition application is a simpler, unrelated task well within the demonstrated UI capability.
metadata.task_rationale: Applying a transition via the Slide Show > Transitions panel is a straightforward one-step task requiring the same UI navigation skills demonstrated in the reliable prefix.
metadata.explanation: Getter reads the PPTX file and checks the XML transition element for each slide. Metric computes the fraction of slides with the Fade transition. Score is 1.0 only when all 28 slides have Fade applied. Initial state has no transitions, so it will not pass initially.
